title: Observational Database on Deep Brain Stimulation in Tourette Syndrome
official: Pre et Post-operative Evaluation of Patients With Tourette Syndrome Treated With High Frequency Bilateral Stimulation of the Anterior Part of the Internal Pallid Globus
summary: Within an ongoing deep brain stimulation (DBS) program for Tourette syndrome (TS) at the Department of Neurology, Pitié-Salpêtrière Hospital, Paris/France, the investigator team plans to evaluate patients pre-operatively and then at one year intervals post-operatively until the 5-year mark has been achieved. The investigator team will investigate tic severity, psychiatric co-morbidities, quality of life, and neuropsychological measures.

interventions.name: Neurological and neuropsychological Follow-up after deep brain stimulation

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Tourette syndrome severe and drug-resistant eligible for bilateral deep brain stimulation
* Person who voluntarily and knowledgeably agreed to participate in the study

Exclusion Criteria:

* Non affiliation to a French social security system (recipient or assign) excluding AME
